c: Requests › Open requests and Open items in the workspace.
say: Find requests under open requests and open items in the workspace.

c: Cancel and add work while the request is pending approval or approved.
say: While a request is pending approval or approved, you can still cancel it.

c: Cancel Request closes its items' tasks with it.
say: Cancel request closes it, and its items' tasks close with it.

c: Add New Item on the classic form, while it waits for approval.
say: On the classic form, add new item adds another item while the request waits for approval.

c: IT approvers find request approvals under Approvals › My approvals.
say: IT approvers find request approvals under my approvals, as for changes.
